title: Algebraized adjunction model of the completed affine comparison
statement: Let $Y$ be Noetherian, $f:X\to Y$ proper, and $J,K$ quasi-coherent ideal sheaves. Assume $f$ is an isomorphism over $Y\setminus V(K)$ [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Fix an adjunction $f^*\dashv f_*$ [def-pc-module-pullback], a coherent formal $J$-system $G$, coherent $F$ on $X$, an isomorphism $\beta:f^*G\simeq F^\wedge$, and coherence of $f_*F$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. Let $\kappa:(f_*F)^\wedge\to f_*(F^\wedge)$ have $\pi_n\kappa_n=f_*(\pi_n)$ and let $\alpha:G\to(f_*F)^\wedge$ have $\alpha_n\kappa_n=\eta_{G_n}f_*(\beta_n)$ at every positive level. For an affine $U$, put $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$, $R=\widehat B_{J(U)}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $L=K(U)R$, and let $Q$ be the ideal sheaf of $L$ on $\operatorname{Spec}R$.  For each such U there exist a scheme Z, a proper morphism p:Z to Spec R which is an isomorphism over Spec R minus V(L), an adjunction p^* left adjoint to p_*, coherent modules A0 on Spec R and F0 on Z, an isomorphism b:p^*A0 to F0, and coherence of p_*F0. There are B-linear isomorphisms from the section inverse limits of G and of the completion of f_*F to the restrictions of the R-modules of sections of A0 and p_*F0. Under these isomorphisms the inverse-limit map of alpha is sections of the adjunction unit followed by p_*b. [def-pc-fibre-product] [pqf-def-coherent] No invertibility of that module map is asserted.

proof.text: For U define R and the canonical map g:Spec R to Y and take Z=pullback f g and p=pullback.snd f g. Noetherianity of the affine sections and of completion supplies a Noetherian completed base. Mathlib AdicCompletion.isAdicComplete together with map_algebraMap_iff supplies completeness for J(U)R.
Apply flat transport to obtain the formal comparison data on Spec R and its commuting inverse-limit square; this includes coherent F0 and coherence of its proper pushforward.
Apply complete-base algebraization to those transported data, obtaining coherent A0, the lifted isomorphism b, and a second square over R.
Properness of p is the Mathlib base-change instance. The complement base-change lemma proves its isomorphism over the required exceptional-ideal complement.

Compose each transport isomorphism with restriction of scalars of the corresponding algebraization isomorphism. The proved private categorical lemma compose_comparison_squares uses associativity and functor map_comp to paste the two squares. Package the displayed witnesses. No data are chosen inside a definition.

theorem formalComparison_completed_affine_adjunction_model
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y]
    (J K : Y.IdealSheafData) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    (hV : IsIso (pullback.snd f (Scheme.Opens.ι K.support.compl)))
    (adj : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (G : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (F : CoherentModules X)
    (β : G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f ≅
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj)
    (h : RingedSpace.IsCoherent Y.toRingedSpace
      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj))
    (κ : formalCompletionSystem J ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ⟶
      formalCompletionSystem (J.comap f) F.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f)
    (α : G ⟶ (completion Y J).obj ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩)
    (hκ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      formalModuleQuotientπ J (n + 1) ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj) ≫
        κ.app (op n) =
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map
        (formalModuleQuotientπ (J.comap f) (n + 1) F.obj))
    (hα : ∀ n : ℕ, α.hom.app (op n) ≫ κ.app (op n) =
      adj.unit.app (G.obj.obj (op n)) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).map (β.hom.app (op n))) :
    ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
      let B := Γ(Y, U.1)
      let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B
      let L := (K.ideal U).map (algebraMap B R)
      let Q := Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
        (L.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R)).inv.hom)
      ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (p : Z ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
        (adjR : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p ⊣ Scheme.Modules.pushforward p)
        (A₀ : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (F₀ : CoherentModules Z)
        (b : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback p).obj A₀.obj ≅ F₀.obj)
        (hD : RingedSpace.IsCoherent (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)).toRingedSpace
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj)),
        IsProper p ∧ IsIso (pullback.snd p (Scheme.Opens.ι Q.support.compl)) ∧
        ∃ eA₀ : limit (G.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≅
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).obj
              ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj A₀.obj),
        ∃ eD₀ : limit (((completion Y J).obj
            ⟨(Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj F.obj, h⟩).obj ⋙
              SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≅
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).obj
              ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj
                ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).obj F₀.obj)),
          lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1))) ≫ eD₀.hom =
          eA₀.hom ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).map
            ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map
              (adjR.unit.app A₀.obj ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward p).map b.hom))
